title: Nonemptiness of pointed quotient comma categories
statement: Let A and B be commutative local rings in one universe, let π:A → B be surjective, and let K and L be separable closures of their respective residue fields. Their A- and B-algebra structures factor through the residue fields as in [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Let H be extension of scalars defined by the ring pushout, as in [lem-sbc-surjective-quotient-base-change]. Fix any B-algebra isomorphism c:H(K) ≅ L and the explicit pointed base-change functor F of [lem-sbc-pointed-etale-quotient-functor]. For every pointed etale B-algebra T, the category of arrows T → F(S), with morphisms commuting with these arrows, is nonempty.

source.place: Tag 04D1, lemma-lift-etale; Tag 05WS, lemma-quotient-strict-henselization; parent proof step 2

proof.text: Transport T to an A/ker π-algebra using quotientKerEquivOfSurjective. Apply exists_etale_coefficientLift. The specified reduction equivalence proves that the Jacobian lift and T form a ring pushout with π: any test map kills the extended kernel, factors through the quotient, and is unique because reduction is surjective. Transport the pushout isomorphism through the equivalence of algebras and under-categories, composing with its unit isomorphism.

Use quotientBaseChange_point_bijective to lift H(S) -> T -> L -> H(K) to S -> K. The defining equation of this lifted point makes the inverse reduction isomorphism a pointed map from T to F(S), hence a structured arrow.

theorem pointedEtaleQuotient_comma_nonempty
    (A K B L : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B] [Field L]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower B (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) L]
    (π : A →+* B) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (c : (quotientBaseChange π).obj (CommAlgCat.of A K) ≅ CommAlgCat.of B L)
    (T : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of B L) ↦ Etale B X.left)) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow T (pointedEtaleBaseChange π c.hom))
